eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 18 · Query Tuning Techniques

code:
-- NON-sargable: function wraps the column
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2026;
-- must compute YEAR() for every row -> scan

-- Sargable: raw column, range predicate
WHERE OrderDate >= '2026-01-01'
  AND OrderDate <  '2027-01-01';
-- optimizer can seek directly
caption: Same result set. Completely different plan.

code:
-- OrderNumber is nvarchar
WHERE OrderNumber = 100245;    -- risky: int literal
                                -- can force per-row conversion

WHERE OrderNumber = '100245';  -- matches the column's type
caption: No visible function — the scan happens anyway.

code:
-- Defeats a covering index on
-- (CustomerId) INCLUDE (OrderDate, TotalDue)
SELECT * FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE CustomerId = 4210;

-- Matches the covering index exactly
SELECT OrderId, OrderDate, TotalDue
FROM dbo.Orders WHERE CustomerId = 4210;
caption: Not just style — it can defeat the index you built.
